text: To start, is the patient awake and responding to you normally, and do they have any chest pain right now?
Yes, he's awake and talking to me normally. He hasn't said anything about chest pain, just his right hip hurting a lot.
Thanks for letting me know about his hip. Could you ask him whether he feels any pain, pressure or tightness in his chest right now?
I don't know, I haven't asked him about his chest yet. He's only been complaining about his hip, which is 7/10 pain for him.
Thanks, that's helpful to know his hip pain is a 7 out of 10. Is he having any trouble breathing right now, or is he bleeding heavily anywhere?
He's awake and talking to me, but I don't know about his breathing or any bleeding. I'm so worried I can't tell.
Thank you, it helps to know he's awake and talking to you. When did his hip start hurting, and do you know how it happened, for example a fall or a knock?
He fell down 4 steps at home about an hour ago and landed on his right hip. It's been hurting since then and he can't stand up.

writes: fell down 4 steps at home, landed on right hip, hurting since, can't stand up

text: Thank you for telling me about his fall down the steps and that he can't stand up. How old is he?
He's 87, he was born on 2 Jan 1939.
Thank you, that's helpful. Does he have a fever or feel hot (if you've taken his temperature, what was it?), and have you noticed any new rash on his skin?
No, he doesn't have a fever and he doesn't feel hot. I haven't seen any rash on him either, and I haven't taken his temperature.
Thank you for checking. Has he travelled overseas in the last two weeks, and has he been around anyone with an infectious illness in that time?
No, he hasn't traveled anywhere, and he has no fever or rash. I don't know of anyone sick he's been around.
Thank you for letting me know. Compared with how he usually is, does he seem more confused, more sleepy, or just not quite himself since the fall?
No, he's awake and talking normally, not confused or sleepy. He's just in a lot of pain from his hip.

writes: a lot of pain from his hip

text: Thank you, I've noted that he's alert and talking normally but in a lot of pain from his hip. What medicines does he take regularly, including any blood thinner like warfarin, apixaban or clopidogrel, and is he allergic to any medicines? You can also send a photo of the boxes.
He takes a small pill to thin his blood, and a blood pressure pill whose name I can't remember. He's allergic to penicillin, it gives him a rash.

writes: a small pill to thin his blood
a blood pressure pill (name not remembered)

text: Thank you, I've noted the blood pressure pill and his penicillin allergy. Just to confirm, the small pill to thin his blood is a blood thinner to prevent clots, like warfarin, apixaban, rivaroxaban or clopidogrel, is that right?
Yes, it's the small pill to thin his blood, but I can't remember the name offhand. I can check the box if you want me to.
Thank you, that would really help. Could you check the box and tell me the name of his blood-thinning pill, or send a photo of it?
I checked the box and it says warfarin. That's the small pill he takes to thin his blood.

sources: CDC Field Triage Guidelines (MMWR 2012 vol. 61 no. 1), Step Four special considerations, p.14 of the report (PDF p.16) (sources/CDC-Field-Triage-2011-MMWR.pdf)

text: Thank you for checking the box, I've noted that he takes warfarin. What is his full name?
His full name is Tan Ah Kow.

note: floor settled - report ready; remaining questions continue

text: Is the pain in his injured leg getting worse and worse, much more than you'd expect, with the leg feeling tight or hard? And are the toes on that leg numb or tingling?
His pain is 7 out of 10 now. I don't know if it's getting worse or if the leg feels tight, and I don't know about numbness or tingling in his toes.
Thank you, that's fine if you're not sure. Did he fall from standing, or from somewhere higher like a ladder, stairs or a window, and roughly how high?
He fell down about 4 steps of the stairs at home. He was walking, not on a ladder or anything higher.

Thank you, that helps. Has a doctor ever said his immune system is weak, for example from cancer treatment, an organ transplant, HIV or steroid medicines, and has a doctor ever told him he has a low platelet count or a bleeding disorder like haemophilia?
I don't know of any of those, he's never told me anything like that. The only thing I know is he takes a small pill to thin his blood.

writes: a small pill to thin his blood

text: Thank you, that's helpful to know about the blood thinner. Are the toes on his injured leg cold, pale or bluish, and can he wiggle them?
I'm not sure, I haven't checked his toes. He's in a lot of pain and I'm afraid to move his leg, so I'll look now if you want me to.
Thank you for letting me know. Does he have a cast or splint on his leg, and if so, does it feel too tight, with the pain or swelling getting worse?
No, he doesn't have a cast or splint on. We haven't put anything on his leg, we're just keeping him still until help comes.
Thank you, that's clear about the cast. Is he having any pain in his testicles or scrotum, and did he get a knock or injury to his belly when he fell?
I don't know about that, sorry. I only know he landed on his right hip and can't stand.

writes: landed on his right hip and can't stand

text: Thank you, that helps to know he landed on his right hip. When he fell, did he hit his head, and did he pass out or black out, even for a moment?
No, he didn't hit his head and he didn't black out. He's awake and talking to me the whole time.
Thank you, it's good to know he didn't hit his head or black out. When did he last have anything to eat or drink, and what was it?
He last ate lunch at 1pm, it was porridge. I don't know about what he drank after that, sorry.
